_about: Recorded engines for the grain banks (docs/47 stage 4). Sources: Sonniss GDC 2021-2023 Game Audio Bundle (royalty-free for games, no attribution, no AI training, raw files not redistributed), fetched with tools/fetch-sonniss.py into ../little-road-audio-sources (outside the repo). Build: python tools/engine-grains.py --config tools/engine-banks.json [--only name ...]. Cylinders, idle and redline describe the recorded car (they guide the rev tracker); trackCylinders: on these vees the bank pulse line (half the firing rate) is the strongest, so the tracker follows that.
